name: Karatsu City
description: Coastal city in Saga Prefecture known for Karatsu Castle, the vibrant Yobuko morning market, the Nanatsugama sea caves, and the Nijinomatsubara pine grove. Famous for Karatsu-yaki pottery and the annual Karatsu Kunchi festival.
descriptionJa: 佐賀県の沿岸都市で、唐津城、活気あふれる呼子朝市、七ツ釜の海食洞、虹の松原で知られています。唐津焼と毎年開催される唐津くんちでも有名です。
